channel.title: Comments on: Firefox keyboard secret shortcut to remove text from page
channel.description: Instant Usability & Web Standards — static archive

item.title: By: Joshua Freislich
item.dc:creator: Joshua Freislich
item.description:
it works on images as well, but the space remains “reserved”. Try pressing ctrl+A to “select all” after an image is removed.

Oh, and this little gem is still a “hidden feature” of adblock. 03 August 2007!

item.title: By: Michael Bothager
item.dc:creator: Michael Bothager
item.description: Upon reading this, I tried do replicate it, and forgot to press the CTRL-key. Lo and behold, it works without the CTRL-key. So it is only SHIFT + double-click which hides the text.
